name: library-webapp
description: The single-page app both Members and Librarians sign into: catalog browsing and search, borrowing and returning books, the chat surface for mood-based suggestions and loan Q&A, and the librarian's catalog management and overdue views. Holds no business data of its own — everything is read from and written to library-api and library-agent.

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Browse/search the catalog, borrow and return books, and view overdue loans.

dependencies.name: library-agent
dependencies.description: Send the member's mood description or plain-language loan question and show the returned reply.
